_note: 0.3.1 level band for EconomyMonitor (src/economy/economy_monitor.gd). Below 'low' x base the daily monitor warms (store buy-backs/bounties up a step, gathering down a step) unless the index is already recovering faster than recovering_per_day or money is growing faster than max_money_growth per day; above 'high' it cools. Delete the level_band block for 0.3.0 behaviour.
